source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. Use it in the Fight phase of either player's turn, right after an enemy unit picks its targets. Choose one of your TERMINATOR units that at least one of that enemy unit's attacks is aimed at. For the rest of the phase, whenever one of its models that has not yet fought this phase is destroyed, roll a D6; if the result is 4+, the model is not removed yet: once the attacking unit has resolved all its attacks, the model can fight, and is removed from play afterwards.

effects.condition: model has not fought this phase
effects.then: not removed; fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then removed from play
